name: shareguard-cli
description: Zero-runtime-dependency Node.js CLI and GitHub Action that scans code, staged changes, and files for hard-coded secrets, provider API keys, and PII, with SARIF output for pre-commit hooks and CI.

scripts.check: node --check src/action.js && node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/format.js && node --check src/git.js && node --check src/ignore.js && node --check src/rules.js && node --check src/scanner.js && npm test
